summary: Rabbi Harari addresses whether a person should stop their seder limud or morning class to be present at a Berit Milah and its Se'udah. He analyzes principles such as HaOsek BaMitzvah Patur Min HaMitzvah, sources in Masechet Mo'ed Katan, Pesachim, and Shiltei Giborim, as well as rulings from Yabiyah Omer and Shevet HaLevi. He explains how to assess whether one's presence is expected to enhance the simcha or if one should stay dedicated to Talmud Torah.
